subject: Re: BlueHarbor - EU tenant data deletion request (prompts / outputs / inference logs)
messages:
From: Ian McAllister <ian@blueharbor.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor Security <security@blueharbor.com>, Elena Soto <elena@blueharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Request: purge prompts/outputs/logs for EU tenant

Hi Karthik,

Per our data residency policy obligations in the EU, we need Redwood to perform a full purge of all prompt text, generated outputs, and associated inference logs for the BlueHarbor EU tenant (tenant id: BH-EU-77). This is a deletion request under our contract and our GDPR obligations. We need:

- Remove PII-bearing prompts and outputs tied to BH-EU-77;
- Delete token-level inference logs for the timeframe 2025-06-01 -> 2026-12-01;
- Provide a machine-readable confirmation (manifest) of deleted items and a short audit extract showing deletion events and checksums.

Can you confirm scope, timeline, and any expected retention windows or backups we need to account for? We prefer completion within 72 hours if possible.

Thanks,
Ian

Ian McAllister
Head of Platform Operations | BlueHarbor Financial
ian@blueharbor.com
+44 20 7946 0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ian McAllister <ian@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:35:50 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: purge prompts/outputs/logs for EU tenant

Ian — thanks for the clear outline. We're on it. High-level plan below; I'll coordinate execution with Priyom (Ops) and loop in Monica for account / procurement visibility.

Planned steps:
1) Scope confirmation: Priyom will run a tenant-scan to enumerate artifacts (prompts, outputs, logs) tied to BH-EU-77 and produce a draft deletion_manifest.
2) Idempotent deletion job: deletion will run against production and streaming KV caches; we will also purge prefix/KV cache and search indices where applicable.
3) Backup retention check: we will review snapshot retention windows (some infra backups may fall outside immediate delete; we will mark them for scheduled expiry or manual wipe where policy permits).
4) Audit & evidence: we will attach a deletion_manifest.csv and a short audit_log_extract.jsonl with deletion events and hashes.
5) Confirmation email with attachments and a signed statement within the SLA window.

Requests for you:
- Confirm that the listed timeframe (2025-06-01 to 2026-12-01) is correct;
- Any special categories to expedite (e.g., payment PII or regulatory case ids).

Target ETA: initial manifest in 24 hours; full completion and signed confirmation within 72 hours subject to backup checks.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:05 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: runbook + required approvals for BH-EU-77 deletion

Team — quick ops note while I start the tenant scan. Summary of procedural items and blockers: 

- Scan: enumerating object ids (prompts, model outputs, token logs) by tenant tag BH-EU-77. Expect ~120M token log rows across sharded stores.
- Backups: Long-term cold snapshots exist for EU region (snapshot retention 90 days by default; some clients opted-in to 365 day archival). Need legal sign-off if there are >90d backups to remove immediately.
- Cross-region caches: there are aggregated analytics indices (EU->us-analytics) that may contain derived artifacts. We will flag them as part of the manifest and request owner approval for deletion.

Required approvals: legal (for backup policy exceptions), security (for verification steps), and account (Monica) for billing/contractary confirmation.

Attachments I will generate and attach to customer confirmation: deletion_manifest_BH-2025-EMP.csv (rows: object_id, object_type, storage_path, deleted_at, checksum), audit_log_extract_20261204.jsonl (sample of deletion events), and a one-page runbook (redwood_deletion_runbook_v2.pdf).

I'll post the initial manifest in ~3 hours. Flagging potential 24-48 hour delay if BlueHarbor has >365d archival snapshots.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Service Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick clarifications:
- 2025-06-01 -> 2026-12-01 window is correct.
- Please treat records flagged with "regulatory_case" tag as highest priority; those are payments and customer dispute threads.
- BlueHarbor does not maintain cold archival longer than 180 days for this tenant; you can proceed with deletion of backups older than 90 days but <=180 days only after confirming hash-based verification.

We appreciate the transparency on the cross-region indices — please include a list of anything you cannot delete immediately.

Best,
Elena Soto
Data Privacy Lead | BlueHarbor Financial
elena@blueharbor.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Ian McAllister <ian@blueharbor.com>, Elena Soto <elena@blueharbor.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:40:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: purge prompts/outputs/logs for EU tenant — COMPLETED (manifest + audit)

Hi Ian / Elena — deletion run completed and validated. Summary and artifacts attached.

What we did:
- Enumerated and removed 4,312,881 prompt records and 2,097,540 generated outputs associated with BH-EU-77.
- Purged token-level inference logs across the window 2025-06-01 -> 2026-12-01: 118,934,012 log rows removed.
- Purged KV/prefix caches and cleared related search index entries where direct mapping existed.
- Marked cross-region analytics indices (2 records) as flagged for manual owner removal — those indices are derived aggregates and require BlueHarbor confirmation to remove. Listed in the manifest under "deferred_deletes".

Attached artifacts (zipped attachments in this thread):
- deletion_manifest_BH-2025-EMP.csv (object_id, object_type, storage_path, deleted_at, checksum)
- audit_log_extract_20261204.jsonl (sample of deletion events with event_id and post-deletion checksum)
- redwood_deletion_runbook_v2.pdf (audit-friendly runbook describing steps + verification)

Verification steps taken:
- Hash verification on deleted object paths matched pre-deletion snapshots for 99.98% of rows; remaining mismatches were tracked and are listed in the manifest (none were PII-tagged).
- Secondary snapshots: we located 2 cold snapshots covering the window (retention policy 180d). Per Elena's note, we did not delete snapshots older than 90d and <=180d without explicit BlueHarbor authorization. These are listed in the manifest as "snapshot_pending_manual_removal".

Next steps for BlueHarbor:
1) Confirm whether you want Redwood to initiate manual removal of the two cold snapshots (we will require a signed waiver from BlueHarbor legal).
2) Confirm deletion of the two flagged cross-region indices.

We are attaching the CSV and JSONL as promised. Please reply to confirm receipt; we can provide a signed statement on company letterhead if you need it for audit filings.

Attachments: deletion_manifest_BH-2025-EMP.csv (attached), audit_log_extract_20261204.jsonl (attached), redwood_deletion_runbook_v2.pdf (attached)

Regards,
Priyom Das
Service Operations | Redwood Inference
